# libtess2

The polygon tessellator Unity's sprite mesh generator calls, from
<https://github.com/memononen/libtess2> at tag `v1.0.2` (commit
`882e5e92953d5ea2626a83da7ffbfd119ef80f53`), unchanged: `Source/*` and `Include/tesselator.h`. SGI Free Software
License B 2.0 (`LICENSE.txt`).

The release matters: where two outlines touch, Unity 6000.0's triangles are
those of this release (and of the commits up to 2018), not those of later
ones or of v1.0.1.
